tracks.title: 1. Kali Linux Mastery & Core Toolsets
tracks.summary: How Kali Linux works, official docs (kali.org), and underlying architecture.
tracks.details: Kali Linux is a Debian-derived Linux distribution tailored for digital forensics and penetration testing. It comes pre-installed with over 600 security tools (Nmap, Metasploit, Wireshark, John the Ripper, Burp Suite, Aircrack-ng). It runs safely inside VirtualBox, VMware, or live USB boot for isolated ethical learning.
tracks.sampleCode:
# Kali Linux — Custom Port & Service Grabber Script
import socket

target = '127.0.0.1'
ports = [21, 22, 80, 443, 8080]
print(f'[*] Kali Linux scan initiated for target: {target}')
for p in ports:
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.settimeout(0.5)
    res = s.connect_ex((target, p))
    if res == 0:
        print(f'[+] Port {p}/tcp OPEN! Service active.')
    else:
        print(f'[-] Port {p}/tcp closed.')
    s.close()
print('[✓] Port scan completed successfully.')

tracks.title: 2. Kali NetHunter Mobile Pentesting
tracks.summary: How Kali NetHunter operates on Android devices and wireless audit methodologies.
tracks.details: Kali NetHunter is the open-source Android penetration testing platform. Powered by a custom kernel and Chroot environment, it supports BadUSB HID keyboard emulation attacks, Mana Rogue Wi-Fi access points, and RF/Bluetooth audits to evaluate mobile and physical hardware security defenses.
tracks.sampleCode:
# Kali NetHunter — BadUSB Keystroke Injection Detector & Guard
import time

def monitor_usb_devices(device_id):
    print(f'[*] NetHunter monitoring USB ID: {device_id}')
    unusual_keystrokes_per_sec = 180
    if unusual_keystrokes_per_sec > 100:
        print('[!] [ALERT] BadUSB HID Injection detected! Disabling rogue keyboard.')
        return False
    return True

status = monitor_usb_devices('USB-HID-KEYBOARD-99')
print(f'[✓] Defense Status: Host secured (Blocked: {not status})')

tracks.title: 3. Deep Web, Dark Web & Tor Network Mechanics
tracks.summary: Differences between Surface, Deep, and Dark Web, 3-Hop Tor onion routing, and legal safety.
tracks.details: The Surface Web represents only ~4% of indexed internet data. The Deep Web comprises ~90% (private databases, banking portals, cloud drives). The Dark Web accounts for ~6%, accessed via Tor's 3-hop onion routing (Guard, Middle, and Exit relays) with multi-layered cryptography. It carries high risks of fraud, scams, and malware. Under Bangladesh Cyber Security Act 2023, unauthorized attacks are illegal.
tracks.sampleCode:
# Tor Network — 3-Hop Onion Routing & IP Leak Checker
def verify_tor_circuit(guard, middle, exit_node):
    print('=== Tor 3-Hop Onion Routing Circuit Verification ===')
    print(f'[1] Guard Relay:  {guard} [Layer 3 Encrypted]')
    print(f'[2] Middle Relay: {middle} [Layer 2 Encrypted]')
    print(f'[3] Exit Node:    {exit_node} [Layer 1 Decrypted]')
    print('[✓] Client origin IP completely hidden and shielded.')
    print('[!] Safety Rule: Never visit illegal or unverified destinations.')

verify_tor_circuit('104.244.72.115:9001', '185.220.101.4:443', '198.98.56.12:80')

tracks.title: 4. Global Network, Internet & Packet Architecture
tracks.summary: Global internet backbones, submarine fiber, BGP routing, and packet filtering.
tracks.details: The global internet relies on submarine optical fiber cables and Autonomous Systems (AS) routing packets via BGP. Transmission operates through the OSI 7-layer and TCP/IP protocol stack, where connections are synchronized via the TCP 3-Way Handshake (SYN -> SYN-ACK -> ACK). Firewalls and IDS/IPS systems inspect packet headers to filter unauthorized exploits.
tracks.sampleCode:
# Global Network — TCP 3-Way Handshake & Packet Tracker
def simulate_tcp_handshake(src_ip, dst_ip, port):
    print(f'[*] Client ({src_ip}) -> Server ({dst_ip}:{port})')
    print('[Step 1] SYN Packet Dispatched (Seq=1000)')
    print('[Step 2] SYN-ACK Received from Host (Seq=5000, Ack=1001)')
    print('[Step 3] ACK Returned (Seq=1001, Ack=5001)')
    print('[✓] TCP handshake verified! Session securely active.')

simulate_tcp_handshake('192.168.1.45', '93.184.216.34', 443)

tracks.title: 5. Business Cyber Attack Defense & Enterprise Data Protection
tracks.summary: Incident containment, ransomware mitigation, and safeguarding enterprise assets.
tracks.details: When an enterprise suffers a cyber breach, immediate containment is critical: (1) Isolate infected nodes from the subnet to prevent lateral movement, (2) Capture volatile memory and syslog dumps for forensic analysis, (3) Restore operations from immutable offline backups, (4) Invalidate domain credentials. Prevention relies on Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and 24/7 SOC monitoring. White hat ethical hackers defend infrastructures legally.
